changes: Parts List bulk actions: select multiple parts to change category, primary vendor, voltage, track inventory, or delete at once
Fixed part images sometimes showing a broken link instead of the picture, both right after install and later on
Images are now served on demand directly from the media pack — no more 15-20 minute background extraction on first launch, so every image is available immediately
Eliminated the partial-extraction bug that left some images permanently broken if the app was closed while images were still unpacking
Installer now copies the media pack into place automatically, so the app is fully ready on first launch
Images added or uploaded inside the app still take priority and work normally
Fixed catalog sync hanging the launcher on upgrades (v1.2.2 fill-blanks pass rewrote millions of rows unconditionally)
Catalog sync default is now insert-only again (1-2s, same as v1.2.1) — your existing data is never touched on update
Fill-blanks pass is now opt-in (--fill-blanks) and per-column so it only updates rows actually missing data
Launcher now runs catalog sync with a 90s hard timeout — the server can never be wedged by a slow sync again
Catalog sync respects --max-seconds budget and aborts gracefully if exceeded
Fixed catalog sync failing silently on upgrades (INSERT OR IGNORE + per-table commits)
Sync now fills in blank fields on existing records from updated seed data
Installer skips media extraction on updates when images already present
Added incremental media sync — only new images are extracted on upgrade
Improved error logging for catalog sync (visible in launcher.log)
Initial release with catalog, inventory, and invoicing
